name: Attempt Sync
description: Sync or view hdlolhfff's Attempt Playback ghosts

upload-my-attempts.name: Upload My Attempts
upload-my-attempts.description: Enable only on your own devices to sync your attempts to hdlolhfff/gd-attempts. Leave off to download and view published playbacks only. Uploads require a GitHub token with Contents read/write access.

github-token.name: GitHub Token
github-token.description: Your own GitHub token for hdlolhfff/gd-attempts. Owner uploads need Contents read/write. Viewers need no token if the repository is public; private viewing needs their own authorized read-only token. Stored locally in plain text; do not share it.

auto-sync.name: Sync at Main Menu
auto-sync.description: Sync when the main menu opens. With Upload My Attempts off, this only downloads playbacks.
